title: 图表作文三段式框架模板
contentEn:
As shown in the chart, [A] and [B] followed opposite trends through [year1] and [year2]. During the time span, [A] witnessed a/an [adj] [increase/decrease]; contrastingly, [B] experienced a/an [adj] [increase/decrease].

What the chart reveals is an ongoing shift in [topic]. Three major factors underlie this emerging trend. For one thing, thanks to the booming economy, a greater portion of the population could [action1]. For another, the technical development has made it possible to [action2]. And with [factor3], it is no surprise that [topic] has witnessed [change] in recent years.

It can be predicted that as [trend], [topic] will [future]. Only by grasping the opportunities and facing up to the challenges can we take full advantage of this new trend and realize [goal].
contentCn: 第一段：描述图表，对比A和B在xx年到xx年间的变化趋势。第二段：分析三大原因——经济发展、技术进步、其他因素。第三段：预测未来趋势，强调抓住机遇、应对挑战。
usageNotes: 适用于趋势对比类图表（柱状图、折线图），填空处替换具体数据。150词左右，是英语二大作文最通用的框架。

sentencePairs.en: As shown in the chart, [A] and [B] followed opposite trends through [year1] and [year2].
sentencePairs.cn: 如图所示，[A]和[B]在[year1]到[year2]年间呈现出相反的变化趋势。

sentencePairs.en: During the time span, [A] witnessed a/an [adj] [increase/decrease]; contrastingly, [B] experienced a/an [adj] [increase/decrease].
sentencePairs.cn: 在此期间，[A]经历了[adj][增加/减少]；相反，[B]经历了[adj][增加/减少]。

sentencePairs.en: What the chart reveals is an ongoing shift in [topic].
sentencePairs.cn: 该图表所揭示的是[topic]正在发生的转变。

sentencePairs.en: Three major factors underlie this emerging trend.
sentencePairs.cn: 三大因素导致了这一新趋势的出现。

sentencePairs.en: For one thing, thanks to the booming economy, a greater portion of the population could [action1].
sentencePairs.cn: 一方面，得益于经济的蓬勃发展，更多人能够[action1]。

sentencePairs.en: For another, the technical development has made it possible to [action2].
sentencePairs.cn: 另一方面，技术进步使得[action2]成为可能。

sentencePairs.en: And with [factor3], it is no surprise that [topic] has witnessed [change] in recent years.
sentencePairs.cn: 且由于[factor3]，[topic]近年来经历了[change]也就不足为奇了。

sentencePairs.en: It can be predicted that as [trend], [topic] will [future].
sentencePairs.cn: 可以预测，随着[trend]，[topic]将会[future]。

sentencePairs.en: Only by grasping the opportunities and facing up to the challenges can we take full advantage of this new trend and realize [goal].
sentencePairs.cn: 只有抓住机遇、应对挑战，我们才能充分利用这一新趋势并实现[goal]。

title: 图表描述万能句式
contentEn:
【开头描述图表】
1. The bar/line/pie chart clearly reflects the changes in [topic] from [year1] to [year2].
2. It is obvious that the chart records [data description], which successfully captures our attention.
3. As can be seen from the chart, the number of [A] has undergone a rather dramatic change from [X] in [year1] to [Y] in [year2].
4. The accurate chart clearly records [topic]. Based on the data of the chart, it could be easily found that [key finding].

【描述具体数据】
5. More than anything else, the percentage of [A] is the highest among all the categories, at [X]%.
6. Remarkably, [A] has experienced the most dramatic change, jumping from [X] to [Y].
7. [A] surpassed/exceeded [B] in [year], nearly [X] times as many as that in [year].
8. The proportion of [A] was [X]% in [year], compared to [Y]% in [year], showing an increase of [Z]%.

【总结数据含义】
9. Obviously, the tendency clearly reflected by the chart should be given more consideration.
10. Isolated as the figures seem to be, they are connected to one another closely.
contentCn: 10个万能句式，涵盖开头引出图表、具体数据描述、总结含义三大场景。可根据图表类型（柱/折/饼）灵活选用。
usageNotes: 这些句式是潘赟冲刺笔记的核心内容。考试时选2-3句用于第一段即可。注意替换方括号中的具体数据。

sentencePairs.en: The bar/line/pie chart clearly reflects the changes in [topic] from [year1] to [year2].
sentencePairs.cn: 该柱状图/折线图/饼图清楚地反映了[topic]从[year1]到[year2]的变化。

sentencePairs.en: It is obvious that the chart records [data description], which successfully captures our attention.
sentencePairs.cn: 显然，该图表记录了[data description]，这成功地吸引了我们的注意。

sentencePairs.en: As can be seen from the chart, the number of [A] has undergone a rather dramatic change from [X] in [year1] to [Y] in [year2].
sentencePairs.cn: 从图表中可以看出，[A]的数量经历了相当显著的变化，从[year1]年的[X]到[year2]年的[Y]。

sentencePairs.en: The accurate chart clearly records [topic]. Based on the data of the chart, it could be easily found that [key finding].
sentencePairs.cn: 该精确图表清楚地记录了[topic]。基于图表数据，可以很容易地发现[key finding]。

sentencePairs.en: More than anything else, the percentage of [A] is the highest among all the categories, at [X]%.
sentencePairs.cn: 最重要的是，[A]的百分比在所有类别中最高，达到[X]%。

sentencePairs.en: Remarkably, [A] has experienced the most dramatic change, jumping from [X] to [Y].
sentencePairs.cn: 值得注意的是，[A]经历了最显著的变化，从[X]跃升至[Y]。

sentencePairs.en: [A] surpassed/exceeded [B] in [year], nearly [X] times as many as that in [year].
sentencePairs.cn: [A]在[year]年超过了[B]，几乎是[year]年的[X]倍。

sentencePairs.en: The proportion of [A] was [X]% in [year], compared to [Y]% in [year], showing an increase of [Z]%.
sentencePairs.cn: [A]的比例在[year]年为[X]%，而[year]年为[Y]%，增长了[Z]%。

sentencePairs.en: Obviously, the tendency clearly reflected by the chart should be given more consideration.
sentencePairs.cn: 显然，图表所清晰反映的趋势应当得到更多关注。

sentencePairs.en: Isolated as the figures seem to be, they are connected to one another closely.
sentencePairs.cn: 尽管这些数字看似孤立，但它们彼此之间联系紧密。

title: 原因分析框架模板
contentEn:
There is no consensus among people regarding the reasons behind the above phenomenon. However, from my point of view, the following two are worthy of more attention.

For one thing, [reason1—economic/social factor]. For another, [reason2—policy/technology factor].

[Alternative version with three reasons:]
Several factors have contributed to this sharp increase. For one thing, [A] has taken steps such as [measure] to [goal]. For another, there is a rising concern over [issue] among [group]. In addition, [factor3] has prompted [group] to [action].

[Alternative version:]
Opinions vary on contributing factors behind the above phenomenon. Nevertheless, from my standpoint, the following two should rank the top two. One significant factor is that [reason1]. In addition, there is the other point that no one can ignore. It is also widely acknowledged that [reason2].
contentCn: 原因分析段的标准框架。提供两种展开方式：双原因版本和三原因版本。替换方括号内容即可。常用表达：经济的快速发展、生活水平提高、政府政策支持、技术进步、公众意识增强。
usageNotes: 适用于图表作文第二段（原因段）。两个原因约60-80词，三个原因约80-100词。注意使用For one thing/For another/In addition等过渡词。

sentencePairs.en: There is no consensus among people regarding the reasons behind the above phenomenon.
sentencePairs.cn: 关于上述现象背后的原因，人们并没有达成共识。

sentencePairs.en: However, from my point of view, the following two are worthy of more attention.
sentencePairs.cn: 然而，在我看来，以下两点更值得关注。

sentencePairs.en: For one thing, [reason1—economic/social factor].
sentencePairs.cn: 一方面，[reason1——经济/社会因素]。

sentencePairs.en: For another, [reason2—policy/technology factor].
sentencePairs.cn: 另一方面，[reason2——政策/技术因素]。

sentencePairs.en: Several factors have contributed to this sharp increase.
sentencePairs.cn: 有几个因素促成了这一急剧增长。

sentencePairs.en: [A] has taken steps such as [measure] to [goal].
sentencePairs.cn: [A]已采取措施，如[measure]，以[goal]。

sentencePairs.en: There is a rising concern over [issue] among [group].
sentencePairs.cn: [group]对[issue]的担忧日益增加。

sentencePairs.en: In addition, [factor3] has prompted [group] to [action].
sentencePairs.cn: 此外，[factor3]促使[group]去[action]。

sentencePairs.en: Opinions vary on contributing factors behind the above phenomenon.
sentencePairs.cn: 关于上述现象背后的促成因素，众说纷纭。

sentencePairs.en: One significant factor is that [reason1].
sentencePairs.cn: 一个重要因素是[reason1]。

sentencePairs.en: It is also widely acknowledged that [reason2].
sentencePairs.cn: 人们也普遍认为[reason2]。

title: 趋势预测结尾段模板
contentEn:
【积极趋势版本】
Taking into account what has been discussed, it is no surprise to see this situation that is likely to continue in the upcoming years. With further economic growth and technological progress, the tendency indicated in the chart will continue.

【中性趋势版本】
According to the analysis above, it is obvious that the trend reflected by the chart will exist for some time in the future.

【建议措施版本】
When all the factors are examined, it is advisable for us to take effective and proper measures. Only in this way can we enjoy the ultimate success.

【展望+建议组合】
Based on the aforesaid discussion, it is advisable for us to [action]. Only by grasping the opportunities and facing up to the challenges can we take full advantage of this new trend and realize [goal].
contentCn: 结尾段的四种写法：积极预测、中性总结、建议措施、展望+建议组合。结尾段通常30-40词，简洁有力地收束全文。
usageNotes: 根据图表反映的趋势性质选择对应版本。正面趋势用积极预测版，负面趋势用建议措施版，中性数据用中性总结版。

sentencePairs.en: Taking into account what has been discussed, it is no surprise to see this situation that is likely to continue in the upcoming years.
sentencePairs.cn: 综上所述，这一情况很可能在未来几年持续下去，这并不令人意外。

sentencePairs.en: With further economic growth and technological progress, the tendency indicated in the chart will continue.
sentencePairs.cn: 随着经济的进一步增长和技术的进步，图表所示的趋势将会延续。

sentencePairs.en: According to the analysis above, it is obvious that the trend reflected by the chart will exist for some time in the future.
sentencePairs.cn: 根据以上分析，图表所反映的趋势显然将在未来一段时间内持续存在。

sentencePairs.en: When all the factors are examined, it is advisable for us to take effective and proper measures.
sentencePairs.cn: 综合所有因素来看，我们应当采取有效且适当的措施。

sentencePairs.en: Only in this way can we enjoy the ultimate success.
sentencePairs.cn: 只有这样，我们才能享受最终的成功。

sentencePairs.en: Based on the aforesaid discussion, it is advisable for us to [action].
sentencePairs.cn: 基于上述讨论，我们应当[action]。

sentencePairs.en: Only by grasping the opportunities and facing up to the challenges can we take full advantage of this new trend and realize [goal].
sentencePairs.cn: 只有抓住机遇、应对挑战，我们才能充分利用这一新趋势并实现[goal]。

title: 柱状图完整范文（环保主题）
contentEn:
It goes without saying that the chart records the area change of forest and desert in China from 1999 to 2019, which successfully arouses our curiosity. As is clearly reflected by the chart, the area of forest and that of desert have witnessed some changes during the past twenty years. Especially, the forest area has experienced the most dramatic change, jumping from 1,590 thousand square kilometers in 1999 to 2,200 thousand square kilometers in 2019. Obviously, the tendency, clearly reflected by the chart, should be given more consideration.

Theoretically, several reasons may make the trend that our country is becoming greener, but for my part, the following two are of the utmost importance. At the top of the list is that being more environmentally conscious, the public participates actively in tree-planting activities. In addition, this issue also stems from the fact that the government has formulated strategic measures like returning farmland to forest or grassland and carried out the ecological environment construction.

According to the analysis above, it is obvious that the trend reflected by the chart will exist for some time in the future.
contentCn: 英语二柱状图真题范文。主题：1999-2019年中国森林和荒漠面积变化。三段式结构：第一段描述数据变化（森林面积从1590增至2200万平方公里）；第二段分析两大原因（公众环保意识+政府政策）；第三段预测趋势持续。
usageNotes: 完整范文，约150词，符合英语二大作文要求。可学习其数据描述方式（jumping from...to...）和原因分析结构。

sentencePairs.en: It goes without saying that the chart records the area change of forest and desert in China from 1999 to 2019, which successfully arouses our curiosity.
sentencePairs.cn: 不言而喻，该图表记录了1999年至2019年中国森林和荒漠的面积变化，这成功地引起了我们的好奇。

sentencePairs.en: As is clearly reflected by the chart, the area of forest and that of desert have witnessed some changes during the past twenty years.
sentencePairs.cn: 如图表清晰所示，森林面积和荒漠面积在过去二十年中都经历了一些变化。

sentencePairs.en: Especially, the forest area has experienced the most dramatic change, jumping from 1,590 thousand square kilometers in 1999 to 2,200 thousand square kilometers in 2019.
sentencePairs.cn: 尤其值得注意的是，森林面积经历了最显著的变化，从1999年的159万平方公里跃升至2019年的220万平方公里。

sentencePairs.en: Obviously, the tendency, clearly reflected by the chart, should be given more consideration.
sentencePairs.cn: 显然，图表所清晰反映的趋势应当得到更多关注。

sentencePairs.en: Theoretically, several reasons may make the trend that our country is becoming greener, but for my part, the following two are of the utmost importance.
sentencePairs.cn: 从理论上讲，有几个原因可能促成我国变得更加绿色的趋势，但就我而言，以下两点最为重要。

sentencePairs.en: At the top of the list is that being more environmentally conscious, the public participates actively in tree-planting activities.
sentencePairs.cn: 首当其冲的是，公众环保意识增强，积极参与植树活动。

sentencePairs.en: In addition, this issue also stems from the fact that the government has formulated strategic measures like returning farmland to forest or grassland and carried out the ecological environment construction.
sentencePairs.cn: 此外，这一问题也源于政府制定了退耕还林还草等战略措施并开展了生态环境建设。

sentencePairs.en: According to the analysis above, it is obvious that the trend reflected by the chart will exist for some time in the future.
sentencePairs.cn: 根据以上分析，图表所反映的趋势显然将在未来一段时间内持续存在。

title: 饼图完整范文（文化消费主题）
contentEn:
The accurate chart clearly records the items of residents' cultural consumption in a city in 2019. Based on the data of the chart, it could be easily found that the cultural consumption items consist of the purchase of creative cultural products, watching art shows, culture and arts training, and others. More than anything else, the percentage of the purchase of creative cultural products is the highest among all the categories, at 43%.

Opinions vary on contributing factors behind the above phenomenon. Nevertheless, from my standpoint, the following two should rank the top two. One significant factor is that with the improvement of people's living standards, cultural activities have been an indispensable part of anyone's life. In addition, there is the other point that no one can ignore. It is also widely acknowledged that creative cultural products can not only appeal to the consumers and meet their needs but also inherit the Chinese traditional culture.

When all the factors are examined, with further economic growth and technological progress, the tendency indicated in the chart will continue.
contentCn: 英语二饼图真题范文。主题：2019年某市居民文化消费项目分布。三段式结构：第一段描述饼图构成（文创产品43%最高）；第二段分析原因（生活水平提高+文创产品魅力）；第三段预测趋势延续。
usageNotes: 完整范文，约150词。饼图写作要点：先总述分类构成，再突出占比最高的项目，用'More than anything else'引导。

sentencePairs.en: The accurate chart clearly records the items of residents' cultural consumption in a city in 2019.
sentencePairs.cn: 该精确图表清楚地记录了2019年某市居民文化消费的项目。

sentencePairs.en: Based on the data of the chart, it could be easily found that the cultural consumption items consist of the purchase of creative cultural products, watching art shows, culture and arts training, and others.
sentencePairs.cn: 基于图表数据，可以很容易地发现文化消费项目包括文创产品购买、观看文艺演出、文化艺术培训及其他。

sentencePairs.en: More than anything else, the percentage of the purchase of creative cultural products is the highest among all the categories, at 43%.
sentencePairs.cn: 最重要的是，文创产品购买的百分比在所有类别中最高，达到43%。

sentencePairs.en: Opinions vary on contributing factors behind the above phenomenon.
sentencePairs.cn: 关于上述现象背后的促成因素，众说纷纭。

sentencePairs.en: One significant factor is that with the improvement of people's living standards, cultural activities have been an indispensable part of anyone's life.
sentencePairs.cn: 一个重要因素是，随着人民生活水平的提高，文化活动已成为每个人生活中不可或缺的一部分。

sentencePairs.en: It is also widely acknowledged that creative cultural products can not only appeal to the consumers and meet their needs but also inherit the Chinese traditional culture.
sentencePairs.cn: 人们也普遍认为，文创产品不仅能吸引消费者、满足其需求，还能传承中国传统文化。

sentencePairs.en: When all the factors are examined, with further economic growth and technological progress, the tendency indicated in the chart will continue.
sentencePairs.cn: 综合所有因素来看，随着经济的进一步增长和技术的进步，图表所示的趋势将会延续。

title: 折线图完整范文（科研创新主题）
contentEn:
It is obvious that the chart clearly reflects the changes in China's research field, which successfully captures our attention. As can be seen from the chart, the number of researchers and the amount of research funding have undergone a rather dramatic change from 2008 to 2018. Remarkably, the amount of research funding has experienced the most dramatic change from 461.6 billion in 2008 to 1967.8 billion in 2018. Accordingly, what this accurate chart depicts should be explored thoroughly and deeply.

There is no consensus among people regarding the reasons behind the above phenomenon. However, from my point of view, the following two are worthy of more attention. For one thing, corporations have to enhance innovative consciousness and improve innovation abilities because they are in an increasingly competitive market. For another, our country has stepped up efforts to support research and development in most fields.

Taking into account what has been discussed, it is no surprise to see this situation that is likely to continue in the upcoming years.
contentCn: 英语二折线图真题范文。主题：2008-2018年中国研发人员和科研经费变化（双折线）。三段式：第一段描述两组数据变化（科研经费从4616亿到19678亿）；第二段分析原因（市场竞争+国家支持）；第三段预测趋势持续。
usageNotes: 完整范文，约150词。折线图注意要同时描述两条线的变化趋势，用Remarkably引出最显著的变化。

sentencePairs.en: It is obvious that the chart clearly reflects the changes in China's research field, which successfully captures our attention.
sentencePairs.cn: 显然，该图表清楚地反映了中国研究领域的变化，这成功地吸引了我们的注意。

sentencePairs.en: As can be seen from the chart, the number of researchers and the amount of research funding have undergone a rather dramatic change from 2008 to 2018.
sentencePairs.cn: 从图表中可以看出，研发人员数量和科研经费金额从2008年到2018年经历了相当显著的变化。

sentencePairs.en: Remarkably, the amount of research funding has experienced the most dramatic change from 461.6 billion in 2008 to 1967.8 billion in 2018.
sentencePairs.cn: 值得注意的是，科研经费金额经历了最显著的变化，从2008年的4616亿增加到2018年的19678亿。

sentencePairs.en: Accordingly, what this accurate chart depicts should be explored thoroughly and deeply.
sentencePairs.cn: 因此，该精确图表所描绘的内容应当被深入透彻地探究。

sentencePairs.en: There is no consensus among people regarding the reasons behind the above phenomenon.
sentencePairs.cn: 关于上述现象背后的原因，人们并没有达成共识。

sentencePairs.en: For one thing, corporations have to enhance innovative consciousness and improve innovation abilities because they are in an increasingly competitive market.
sentencePairs.cn: 一方面，企业必须增强创新意识、提高创新能力，因为它们处于竞争日益激烈的市场中。

sentencePairs.en: For another, our country has stepped up efforts to support research and development in most fields.
sentencePairs.cn: 另一方面，我国加大了对大多数领域研发的支持力度。

sentencePairs.en: Taking into account what has been discussed, it is no surprise to see this situation that is likely to continue in the upcoming years.
sentencePairs.cn: 综上所述，这一情况很可能在未来几年持续下去，这并不令人意外。

title: 图表作文过渡与连接词
contentEn:
【第一段→第二段 过渡句】
1. Accordingly, what this accurate chart depicts should be explored thoroughly and deeply.
2. Obviously, the tendency clearly reflected by the chart should be given more consideration.
3. What the chart reveals is an ongoing shift in [topic].

【第二段 列举原因】
4. Theoretically, several reasons may make this trend, but for my part, the following two are of the utmost importance.
5. There is no consensus among people regarding the reasons. However, from my point of view, the following two are worthy of more attention.
6. Various reasons are behind the situation, but as far as I am concerned, the following two matter greatly.

【第二段内部过渡】
7. For one thing, ... For another, ...
8. At the top of the list is that ... In addition, ...
9. One significant factor is that ... Moreover, ...
10. Firstly, ... Secondly, ... Finally, ...

【第二段→第三段 过渡句】
11. Taking into account what has been discussed above, ...
12. According to the analysis above, ...
13. When all the factors are examined, ...
14. Based on the aforesaid discussion, ...
contentCn: 图表作文各段落之间的过渡句和内部连接词。第一组：一段到二段过渡。第二组：原因列举引入句。第三组：原因之间的并列连接。第四组：二段到三段过渡。
usageNotes: 过渡句是作文流畅性的关键。每个过渡位置准备1-2个句式，考试时灵活选用，避免所有文章用相同过渡。

sentencePairs.en: Accordingly, what this accurate chart depicts should be explored thoroughly and deeply.
sentencePairs.cn: 因此，该精确图表所描绘的内容应当被深入透彻地探究。

sentencePairs.en: Obviously, the tendency clearly reflected by the chart should be given more consideration.
sentencePairs.cn: 显然，图表所清晰反映的趋势应当得到更多关注。

sentencePairs.en: What the chart reveals is an ongoing shift in [topic].
sentencePairs.cn: 该图表所揭示的是[topic]正在发生的转变。

sentencePairs.cn: 一方面……另一方面……

title: 书信类小作文通用框架
contentEn:
Dear [Recipient],

I am writing to [purpose of the letter—express/apply/invite/suggest/complain/etc.]. [Brief self-introduction if necessary].

[Body paragraph 1: details/reasons/requirements]. [Use transition: First and foremost / Firstly / For one thing].

[Body paragraph 2: additional information]. [Use transition: What's more / In addition / For another]. [If applicable, add a third point with Finally / Lastly].

[Closing sentence expressing expectation or gratitude]. [I am looking forward to your reply / I would be grateful if you could... / Thank you for your time].

Sincerely yours,
Li Ming
contentCn: 英语二小作文书信通用模板。结构：称呼→写信目的→正文（2-3个要点）→结尾礼貌语→署名。称呼用Dear Sir or Madam（正式）/ Dear + 姓名（非正式），署名固定为Li Ming。
usageNotes: 英语二小作文要求100词左右。三段式可灵活安排：一段30词（目的+自我介绍），二段50词（主体内容2-3点），三段20词（礼貌结尾）。所有书信类（建议信、邀请信、投诉信、推荐信、求职信、道歉信、感谢信、咨询信）都可以套用。

sentencePairs.en: Dear [Recipient],
sentencePairs.cn: 尊敬的[收信人]：

sentencePairs.en: I am writing to [purpose of the letter].
sentencePairs.cn: 我写信是为了[信件目的]。

sentencePairs.en: I am a student in this university who is [self-introduction].
sentencePairs.cn: 我是本校的一名学生，[自我介绍]。

sentencePairs.en: First and foremost, ...
sentencePairs.cn: 首先……

sentencePairs.en: What's more, ... / In addition, ...
sentencePairs.cn: 更重要的是……/此外……

sentencePairs.en: I am looking forward to your reply.
sentencePairs.cn: 我期待您的回复。

sentencePairs.en: I would be grateful if you could...
sentencePairs.cn: 如果您能……我将不胜感激。

sentencePairs.en: Thank you for your time.
sentencePairs.cn: 感谢您的时间。

sentencePairs.en: Sincerely yours,
sentencePairs.cn: 您真诚的，

sentencePairs.en: Li Ming
sentencePairs.cn: 李明

title: 通知/公告完整模板
contentEn:
Notice
[Date, e.g. May 20, 2019]

To [purpose/background], [organizer] is going to host/organize [event name] on [date], in [location].

We would like to introduce it in detail. Firstly, [requirement/rule 1]. Secondly, [requirement/rule 2]. [Thirdly, additional info if needed].

If you are interested, please do not hesitate to [action—contact/sign up/participate]. We are really looking forward to your participation.

[Organizer name, e.g. Students' Union]

---
[Alternative: Announcement for club/speech contest]

[Event Title]

To enhance [goal] and enrich [target activity], [organizer] is organizing [event], which is to be held on [date] at [location]. Firstly, [detail 1]. Secondly, [detail 2].

Those who are interested in taking part in it may sign up with [contact] before [deadline]. If the would-be candidates have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact us at [email].

Everybody is welcome to be present at the contest.

[Organizer]
contentCn: 通知/公告类小作文的双模板。模板1（Notice格式）：用于活动通知，包含时间、地点、要求、参与方式。模板2（Announcement格式）：用于比赛/俱乐部公告，更正式，包含活动目的、评选细节、报名方式。
usageNotes: 通知不同于书信，不需要Dear开头和Sincerely结尾。Notice要居中写标题，日期在右上角。署名写组织名称（如Students' Union），不能用Li Ming。约100词。

sentencePairs.en: Notice
sentencePairs.cn: 通知

sentencePairs.cn: 为了[purpose]，[organizer]将于[date]在[location]举办[event]。

sentencePairs.en: We would like to introduce it in detail.
sentencePairs.cn: 我们想详细介绍一下。

sentencePairs.cn: 如果您感兴趣，请随时[action]。

sentencePairs.cn: 我们真诚期待您的参与。

sentencePairs.cn: 欢迎大家前来观看比赛。

title: 建议信完整模板
contentEn:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am a student in this university who is [self-introduction—e.g. a member of the Environmental Protection Association]. The efforts that you make to [current situation] are quite great. However, I have some better suggestions for you.

Firstly, it would be greatly appreciated if you could [suggestion 1] because it could [benefit 1] and [benefit 2]. Moreover, [suggestion 2] is a requirement, so it is advisable for you to [action].

I would be grateful if you find these suggestions helpful.

Sincerely yours,
Li Ming
contentCn: 英语二建议信完整模板。范文主题：给大学相关部门写建议信改善校园公共环境。三段结构：自我介绍+表达建议意图→具体建议（垃圾分类+更新设施）→礼貌结尾。
usageNotes: 建议信要点：语气礼貌（would be grateful/appreciated），建议具体可操作（用Firstly/Moreover列举），说明建议的好处（because it could...）。约100词。

sentencePairs.en: Dear Sir or Madam,
sentencePairs.cn: 尊敬的先生/女士：

sentencePairs.en: I am a student in this university who is [self-introduction].
sentencePairs.cn: 我是本校的一名学生，[自我介绍]。

sentencePairs.en: The efforts that you make to [current situation] are quite great.
sentencePairs.cn: 您为[当前情况]所做的努力非常了不起。

sentencePairs.en: However, I have some better suggestions for you.
sentencePairs.cn: 然而，我有一些更好的建议给您。

sentencePairs.en: Firstly, it would be greatly appreciated if you could [suggestion 1] because it could [benefit 1] and [benefit 2].
sentencePairs.cn: 首先，如果您能[suggestion 1]，我将不胜感激，因为这可以[benefit 1]和[benefit 2]。

sentencePairs.en: Moreover, [suggestion 2] is a requirement, so it is advisable for you to [action].
sentencePairs.cn: 此外，[suggestion 2]是必需的，因此您最好[action]。

sentencePairs.en: I would be grateful if you find these suggestions helpful.
sentencePairs.cn: 如果您觉得这些建议有帮助，我将不胜感激。

title: 邀请信完整模板
contentEn:
Dear [Name/Title],

On behalf of [organization], I cordially invite you to [event/lecture/activity]. [It is scheduled for / We are hoping that you will be available for] [date/time] at [location].

As you are one of the [outstanding experts / distinguished scholars] in [field], I believe that [the audience/students] will not only be able to learn from you, but to be inspired by you as well. [Event details: There will be X minutes allocated for your lecture and Y minutes for a question-and-answer session.]

If you are interested in this event, you can email me at [email address]. We are looking forward to meeting you.

Sincerely yours,
Li Ming
contentCn: 英语二邀请信完整模板。范文主题：邀请知名教授来校做英语讲座。三段结构：表明邀请意图+时间地点→说明邀请理由+活动安排→提供联系方式+期待回复。
usageNotes: 邀请信要点：开头用cordially/on behalf of表正式，中间说明对方重要性（not only...but also...），结尾提供具体联系方式。约100词。

sentencePairs.en: On behalf of [organization], I cordially invite you to [event].
sentencePairs.cn: 我谨代表[organization]，诚挚地邀请您参加[event]。

sentencePairs.en: It is scheduled for [date] at [location].
sentencePairs.cn: 活动定于[date]在[location]举行。

sentencePairs.en: As you are one of the distinguished scholars in [field], I believe that the audience will not only be able to learn from you, but to be inspired by you as well.
sentencePairs.cn: 作为[field]领域的杰出学者，我相信听众不仅能从您身上学到知识，还能受到您的启发。

sentencePairs.en: There will be X minutes allocated for your lecture and Y minutes for a question-and-answer session.
sentencePairs.cn: 您的讲座将安排X分钟，问答环节安排Y分钟。

sentencePairs.en: If you are interested in this event, you can email me at [email address].
sentencePairs.cn: 如果您对此活动感兴趣，可以发邮件至[email address]联系我。

sentencePairs.en: We are looking forward to meeting you.
sentencePairs.cn: 我们期待着与您见面。

title: 投诉信完整模板
contentEn:
Dear Sir or Madam,

As a regular [passenger/customer/user] of your [service/product], I am severely disappointed to find that the service you have recently provided is far from satisfactory. Therefore, I am writing this letter to draw your attention to the matter in the hope that the present situation can be improved.

As we all know, [quality/feature] is essential to the [service/product]. However, [problem 1], which has brought me much trouble and inconvenience. Even worse are [problem 2—describe in more detail].

I believe you will take this matter into serious consideration and give a satisfactory reply as soon as possible.

Sincerely yours,
Li Ming
contentCn: 英语二投诉信完整模板。范文主题：投诉火车服务差。三段结构：表明身份+引出投诉→具体投诉问题（晚点+服务态度差）→要求回复和改善。
usageNotes: 投诉信要点：先说明身份建立credibility（As a regular...），语气坚定但不过激（far from satisfactory比bad更得体），最后要求对方认真对待。约100词。

sentencePairs.en: As a regular [customer] of your [service], I am severely disappointed to find that the service you have recently provided is far from satisfactory.
sentencePairs.cn: 作为贵[service]的常[customer]，我非常失望地发现您最近提供的服务远不能令人满意。

sentencePairs.en: Therefore, I am writing this letter to draw your attention to the matter in the hope that the present situation can be improved.
sentencePairs.cn: 因此，我写此信以引起您对此事的关注，希望现状能够得到改善。

sentencePairs.en: As we all know, [quality] is essential to the [service].
sentencePairs.cn: 众所周知，[quality]对[service]至关重要。

sentencePairs.en: However, [problem 1], which has brought me much trouble and inconvenience.
sentencePairs.cn: 然而，[problem 1]，这给我带来了很多麻烦和不便。

sentencePairs.en: I believe you will take this matter into serious consideration and give a satisfactory reply as soon as possible.
sentencePairs.cn: 我相信您会认真考虑此事，并尽快给予满意的答复。

title: 道歉信完整模板
contentEn:
Dear [Name],

I am sorry to say that I will not be able to attend [event/appointment] at [time/date].

Unfortunately, I have recently been diagnosed with [reason—illness/emergency situation] which will require [action] on the same day as our [event]. If possible, I would like to postpone [the event] to another day later in the week. I promise that such a situation does not usually happen, and apologize for any inconvenience this may cause you.

I am looking forward to hearing from you and, again, am sorry for any trouble this may have caused. Please excuse me for not being able to inform you of my situation sooner.

Sincerely yours,
Li Ming
contentCn: 英语二道歉信完整模板。范文主题：因病无法参加面试。三段结构：直接道歉说明无法出席→解释原因+提出补救方案→再次道歉+请求谅解。
usageNotes: 道歉信要点：开头直接道歉（I am sorry to say...），解释原因要具体合理化（diagnosed with...），主动提出补救方案（postpone to another day），结尾再三道歉。约100词。

sentencePairs.en: I am sorry to say that I will not be able to attend [event] at [time].
sentencePairs.cn: 很抱歉，我无法在[time]参加[event]。

sentencePairs.en: Unfortunately, I have recently been diagnosed with [illness] which will require [action] on the same day as our [event].
sentencePairs.cn: 不幸的是，我最近被诊断出[illness]，需要在[event]当天进行[action]。

sentencePairs.en: If possible, I would like to postpone [the event] to another day later in the week.
sentencePairs.cn: 如果可能的话，我想将[event]推迟到本周晚些时候的另一天。

sentencePairs.en: I promise that such a situation does not usually happen, and apologize for any inconvenience this may cause you.
sentencePairs.cn: 我保证这种情况通常不会发生，并对给您带来的不便表示歉意。

sentencePairs.en: I am looking forward to hearing from you and, again, am sorry for any trouble this may have caused.
sentencePairs.cn: 我期待您的回复，并再次为由此造成的任何麻烦表示歉意。

sentencePairs.en: Please excuse me for not being able to inform you of my situation sooner.
sentencePairs.cn: 请原谅我没能更早地告知您我的情况。

title: 小作文万能开头与结尾句
contentEn:
【万能开头句】
1. I am writing to express my [concern/suggestion/invitation/gratitude/apology/application]...
2. I am writing to draw your attention to...
3. I am a student in this university who is [identity/background].
4. On behalf of [organization], I am writing to...
5. As a regular [user/customer] of your [service/product], I am writing to...

【万能结尾句】
6. I am looking forward to hearing from you at your earliest convenience.
7. Thank you for your time. Your prompt attention to this matter would be highly appreciated.
8. I would be grateful if you could take my [suggestions/application] into consideration.
9. I believe you will take this matter into serious consideration and give a satisfactory reply as soon as possible.
10. If you have any questions, please feel free to contact me.
11. We are really looking forward to your participation.
12. I hope that you will find [this recommendation/these suggestions] worthy of consideration.
contentCn: 小作文12个万能句，覆盖开头（表明写信目的/身份）和结尾（期待回复/感谢关注/礼貌收束）两大场景。无论什么书信类型都可以从中选用。
usageNotes: 开头句1-5按信件类型选用；结尾句6-12按语气需求选用（正式/非正式）。建议每种信件类型固定搭配一组开头+结尾，考试时直接套用。
